questions.questionStem: If Foster presents on Saturday, which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: All verified solutions have Foster on day 6. When we filter those solutions, all of them have Brennan on day 1 (Monday). This must be true given the constraints: Adler is on day 2, and Brennan must come before Chavez. With only days 1, 3, 4, 5 remaining for Brennan, Chavez, Dalton, and Erickson (and Erickson before Foster on day 6), Brennan must occupy day 1.
explanations.A: Adler (day 2) is not always before Erickson. In solutions 1–4, Erickson is on day 5; in solutions 5–6, Erickson is on day 1. When Erickson is on day 1, Adler on day 2 is after Erickson. Could be true, not must be true.
explanations.C: Chavez and Dalton's relative order varies across the solutions. In solutions 1 and 3, Chavez is day 3 and Dalton is day 4 or 5, so Chavez before Dalton. In solutions 2 and 4, Dalton is day 3 or 4 and Chavez is day 4 or 5, so order varies. Could be true, not must be true.
explanations.D: Erickson comes before Foster (rule 3), but Erickson's position relative to Dalton varies. Could be true, not must be true.
explanations.E: Dalton is on day 4 in some solutions, but also on other days. Could be true, not must be true.

questions.questionStem: If Brennan presents before Erickson, which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: Under the base rules, Brennan before Erickson is satisfied in all verified solutions (Brennan is day 1 or 3, Erickson is day 1 or 3 or 5, depending on configuration). Solution 1 has Brennan on day 1, Erickson on day 5; solution 2 has Brennan on day 1, Erickson on day 5; solution 3 has Brennan on day 1, Erickson on day 3; solution 4 has Brennan on day 1, Erickson on day 3; solution 5 has Brennan on day 3, Erickson on day 1... wait, that violates Brennan before Erickson. So solution 5 and 6 must be excluded if we add the local rule Brennan before Erickson. Remaining solutions: 1–4. In solution 1, Dalton is day 4. In solution 2, Dalton is day 3. In solution 3, Dalton is day 5. In solution 4, Dalton is day 4. So Dalton on day 5 (Friday) is possible in solution 3.
explanations.A: Erickson is never on day 1 (Brennan or Erickson are on day 1, but Erickson is only on day 1 in solutions 5–6, which we excluded). Cannot be true under the local rule.
explanations.B: Adler is always on day 2, never on day 1. Cannot be true.
explanations.C: Foster is always on day 6, never on day 4. Cannot be true.
explanations.E: Foster is always on day 6 (Saturday), not Chavez. Cannot be true.
